description: Pixel art portrait of just the floating head of a ship's AI, no neck, no shoulders, no body, a hologram of a woman's face, calm, half-lidded and mildly unimpressed, a dry little almost-smile, short hair, facing the viewer, drawn as a pale white-blue wireframe of glowing lines over translucent light, faint glitch at the edges, projected inside a dark ship console with a few cold indicator lights, deep indigo dark filling every edge, no lettering
